comments.body: Type left as Unknown on purpose. Under E3, a group of mixed types that the filing does not split out is recorded as Unknown, so Unknown is right whoever the nine IOI bidders were. The filing does not name them; see Q4.

Review, 23 Sep: all 63 rows checked against the filing and instruction v1.13.2 (edits: #17 note, #42/#43 notes). Questions Q1-Q8: agree with every recommended answer. Closest calls: Q3 (05/19 outcome Unclear rather than Late bids accepted), Q6 (#44 Formal as resting on Party D's July mark-ups), Q7 (Party E Dropped by target by 08/04; alternative Not selected at signing 08/12). Q4 is firmer than stated: 8 LOI invitees = 6 LOIs + 2 non-submitters, so B, G&W, D, E, F are 5 of the 7. Q2: if G&W and Party B are among the 11, #8's cohort Count would be 9.
